about: A won game of The Detective, played in VICE from the hand-over snapshot (work/entry.vsf, loaded under the name detective-entry) with stick (port 2) and keyboard input only. Ops: load a snapshot; j: stick bits (1 up, 2 down, 4 left, 8 right, 16 fire); f: run frames; s: run instructions; kd, ku: key down, key up (matrix names). Milestones: frame, log position when recorded, what, room ($48), clock; route_replay.py checks them by frame. Recorded by frame, not by the game's reads of its controls, so it replays only in VICE from that snapshot.
